build_agent_with_AgentBuilder: build a default simulation agent using AgentBuilder with an agent config and environment
list_agents_with_AgentBuilder: list all available agent names by calling list_agents on an AgentBuilder instance
build_app_agent_with_AppAgentBuilder: build a default app agent using AppAgentBuilder with an app, config, and environment
list_app_agents_with_AppAgentBuilder: list all available app agent names by calling list_agents on an AppAgentBuilder instance
create_custom_AgentBuilder_subclass: create a custom agent builder by subclassing AbstractAgentBuilder and implementing list_agents and build methods
